units.title: Actual PBPS: L2 continuity at time zero, not yet a semigroup

sources.label: Appendix A.1, Proposition A.1(ii), final strong-continuity paragraph
sources.scope: Only zero-time strong continuity; restart/semigroup, positivity/constants, independent-reference averaging, hypocoercivity, errors, costs and composition remain open.

assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero.
V is C2, alpha>0, alpha<=beta, and alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v. Also eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
The actual process, invariant probability law, L2 operators, integrability and dense-core convergence are constructed/proved internally, not supplied premises.
L2 is a quotient by almost-everywhere equality. All AE statements are parameterwise. Nonnegative-time neighborhoods include t=0.
units.statement: Under the displayed hypotheses put V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), pi_y=volume.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E) and nu_y=pi_y times gamma. Use the literal fixed-reference PBPS harmonic-flight/bounce recursion with independent unit exponential clocks, covered-arc interpolation and the initial-phase raw fallback. There exists one global jointly measurable actual process Z, and for every center y and reference r a family of continuous real linear operators A_t on L2(nu_y), with A_0=I and ||A_t||<=1. For every raw G with MemLp G 2 nu_y, its clock sections are integrable for nu_y-almost every initial phase, op_t G(z)=integral G(Z(y,r,z,t,w))dP(w) belongs to L2, and A_t[G]=[op_t G]. All previous fixed-time Gibbs invariance, bounded signed duality, flip and Gaussian-averaging conclusions hold on this SAME process and family. In particular the canonical momentum flip J is an involutive isometry, A_t*=J A_t J; the position pullback B is isometric, M=B* is Gaussian integration for arbitrary MemLp representatives, MB=I, JB=B, MJ=M; and K_t=M A_t B is a self-adjoint contraction with K_0=I and its literal Gaussian-outer/clock-inner representative, with both AE integrability obligations retained. In addition, for every f in real L2(nu_y), A_t f tends to f in L2 as nonnegative t tends to zero. No process or operator is substituted. No semigroup law or positive-time continuity is asserted.
units.boundary: Zero-time real-L2 strong continuity only. Restart/semigroup, Markov positivity/constants, separate kernel-witness identification, independent-reference half-turn averaging, final discrete hypocoercivity, implementation errors, actual expected costs, composition and all four complete papers remain open.

steps.title: Identify the same actual process
steps.text: The two producer theorems have the same literal record recursion. On a covered interval, finite event time forces a live record and both representatives follow the same harmonic flight. Outside coverage both return the initial phase. This identifies Z pointwise, including raw exceptional inputs, before comparing expectations.
steps.detail: ASTIS completion: equality of two existential witnesses is proved, never assumed.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨Z, hZm, hZa, hZf, hZ0, h106, hBorel, h109⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPositionL2Averaging.actual_position_l2_averaging
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  obtain ⟨Zb, hZbm, hZba, hZbf, hZbAE, hshort, htest, houter⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualOuterBoundedL2Continuity.actual_outer_bounded_l2_continuity
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have hZeq : Zb = Z := by
    funext y xRef z t w
    by_cases hx : ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z t n
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, record y xRef z (ε w) n = Sum.inl a := by
        cases hr : record y xRef z (ε w) n with
        | inl a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
        | inr u =>
          have hh := hn.1
          change (record y xRef z (ε w) n).elim
            (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤) ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) at hh
          rw [hr] at hh
          exact False.elim ((WithTop.not_top_le_coe t) hh)
      exact (hZba y xRef z w t n a hn.1 hn.2 ha).trans
        (hZa y xRef z w t n a hn ha).symm
    · exact (hZbf y xRef z w t hx).trans (hZf y xRef z w t hx).symm
  rw [hZeq] at houter

steps.title: Identify the exact probability law
steps.text: The old exponent -V-q equals -(V+q), where q=||x-y||^2/(2 eta). Congruence identifies the tilted measures and Gaussian products. The old bounded-core theorem supplies probability internally, hence the finiteness needed below.
steps.detail: No new normalizer or finite-mass assumption.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨Z, hZm, hZa, hZf, hZ0, h106, hBorel, ?_⟩
  intro y xRef
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hL, hR, hJ⟩ := h109 y xRef
  refine ⟨L, hL0, ?_, hL, hR, hJ⟩
  have hnu :
      ((volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))).prod
        (stdGaussian E) = nu y := by
    apply congrArg (fun μ : Measure E => μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    apply congrArg ((volume : Measure E).tilted)
    funext x
    dsimp only [Vy]
    ring
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (nu y) := by
    rw [← hnu]
    exact (houter.1 y).2

steps.title: Convert the bounded-core integral limit into norm convergence
steps.text: For bounded continuous g choose its L2 class. Operator identification and AE congruence give the displayed identity via the real L2 inner product. The existing dominated-convergence theorem makes the right side tend to zero. Continuity of square root gives norm convergence.
steps.detail: The source uses C_c; ASTIS reuses its explicitly attributed stronger C_b core. The existing 4||g||_infty^2 domination is a dependency. L2 representatives agree only AE, not pointwise.
steps.lean:
have hcore (g : (E × E) →ᵇ ℝ) :
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => L t (BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ g))
        (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ g)) := by
    let f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) := BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ g
    have hf : (f : (E × E) → ℝ) =ᵐ[nu y] g :=
      BoundedContinuousFunction.coeFn_toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ g
    have hg : MemLp g 2 (nu y) := MemLp.ae_eq hf (Lp.memLp f)
    have hfg : hg.toLp g = f := by
      apply Lp.ext
      exact hg.coeFn_toLp.trans hf.symm
    have hlimit := (houter.2 y xRef g g.continuous ‖g‖ (norm_nonneg g)
      (fun z => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using g.norm_coe_le_norm z)).2
    dsimp only at hlimit
    rw [hnu] at hlimit
    have hnorm (t : ℝ≥0) :
        ‖L t f - f‖ ^ 2 =
          ∫ z, ((∫ w, g (Z y xRef z t w) ∂P) - g z) ^ 2 ∂nu y := by
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨hop, he⟩, _⟩ := (hL t).2 g hg
      rw [hfg] at he
      have ha : (L t f : (E × E) → ℝ) =ᵐ[nu y]
          (fun z => ∫ w, g (Z y xRef z t w) ∂P) := by
        rw [he]
        exact hop.coeFn_toLp
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq (L t f - f), L2.inner_def]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (L t f) f, ha, hf] with z hz hzA hzf
      simp only [hz, Pi.sub_apply, hzA, hzf, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, pow_two]
    have hnormlimit : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ‖L t f - f‖ ^ 2) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [hnorm] using hlimit
    have hsqrt := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hnormlimit
    change Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => Real.sqrt (‖L t f - f‖ ^ 2))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (Real.sqrt 0)) at hsqrt
    have hzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ‖L t f - f‖) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_norm, Real.sqrt_zero] using hsqrt
    exact tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr hzero

steps.title: Extend to every L2 observable
steps.text: For arbitrary f choose a nearby bounded-continuous core class g. Uniform contractivity bounds both approximation terms; core convergence handles the remaining term. Equivalently, the uniformly Lipschitz operators have a closed convergence locus containing a dense range. Lean invokes the existing Mathlib equicontinuity and density theorems for this epsilon argument.
steps.detail: Finite Borel measures on this metrizable phase space have the required weak regularity. This proves continuity at zero, not restart or semigroup identities.
steps.lean:
have hequi : Equicontinuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) => L t f) := by
    apply Metric.equicontinuous_of_continuity_modulus id tendsto_id
    intro f g t
    have hlip : LipschitzWith 1 (L t) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.lipschitzWith_of_opNorm_le (hL t).1
    simpa only [id_eq, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using hlip.dist_le_mul f g
  have hclosed : IsClosed {f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) |
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => L t f) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 f)} :=
    hequi.isClosed_setOfPred_tendsto continuous_id
  have hdense : DenseRange (BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ :
      ((E × E) →ᵇ ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 (nu y)) :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp_denseRange ℝ (nu y) ℝ (by norm_num)
  have hsubset : Set.range (BoundedContinuousFunction.toLp 2 (nu y) ℝ :
      ((E × E) →ᵇ ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 (nu y)) ⊆
      {f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) | Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => L t f) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 f)} := by
    rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact hcore g
  intro f
  exact closure_minimal hsubset hclosed (hdense f)
